title: Employees
text: Everyone who works here, where they work and their employment history.

list.empty_text: Hire the first person to start keeping records here.
list.none_text: Try another name or code, or clear the filters.

hire_page.title: Hire someone
hire_page.text: Their employee code is given when you save.
hire_page.no_probation: No probation here: they are confirmed at once.

profile.not_found: This employee was not found, or is not part of this organization.
profile.conflict: Someone changed this employee a moment ago. The latest details are shown now; make your change again.
profile.revealed_note: Looking at the full ids is recorded in the audit log.

steps.exits_on_hint: Left empty: {count} days of notice from the effective date.
steps.exit_confirm_text: They will be marked as left from the last working day. Their records stay, and they can be rehired later.

documents.file_hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {kb} KB.
documents.remove_text: The file is deleted. This is recorded in the audit log.
documents.empty_text: Contracts, certificates and copies of ids kept for this employee appear here.

positions.title: Positions
positions.text: Job titles people can hold here, in both languages.
positions.empty_text: Add the job titles of this organization, for example Teacher or Accountant.

no_access: You can see employees but not change them. Ask an owner for HR rights.

fields_page.title: Extra fields
fields_page.text: Details you ask about every employee here, beyond the usual ones (blood group, licence number, shift).
fields_page.at_limit: Switch one off to add another.
fields_page.empty_text: Add the details your organization keeps about people, for example blood group or a licence number.
fields_page.label: Name of the field
fields_page.key_hint: Used in import files; cannot change later.

import_page.title: Import employees
import_page.text: Add many people at once from a spreadsheet. Every row is checked first; nothing is saved until you start.
import_page.how_template: Download the template and open it in Excel or Google Sheets.
import_page.how_fill: Fill in one person per row. Always needed: {columns}.
import_page.how_save: Save as "CSV UTF-8" and choose the file below.
import_page.hint_kinds: permanent, contract, part_time, intern, daily_wage (as offered here)
import_page.hint_codes: codes shown in the app; the manager must already be an employee
import_page.unit_hint: A row can name another unit in unit_code.
import_page.file_hint: Up to {rows} people and {kb} KB per file.
import_page.running_note: You can leave this page; the import continues.
import_page.skip_one: Leave out the row with problems
import_page.skip_other: Leave out the {count} rows with problems
import_page.cancel_text: Nobody from this file is added. You can check a corrected file any time.

org_chart.title: Org chart
org_chart.text: Who reports to whom. Open a person to see the people who report to them.
org_chart.empty_text: Hire people and set their managers to see the org chart.
org_chart.toggle_one: Show or hide the person who reports to {name}
org_chart.toggle_other: Show or hide the {shown} people who report to {name}
org_chart.more_one: 1 more is not shown here. Use the employee list to find them.
org_chart.more_other: {shown} more are not shown here. Use the employee list to find them.

login.label: Login
login.none: Not linked: they cannot check in or see their own records yet.
login.title: Link a login
login.text: Choose the login {name} uses. They can then check in and see their own records.
login.empty: No member of the company to link. Invite them first under Members.
login.unlink_text: {name} can no longer check in with it. Their records stay.
